'''Kombat Duel''' is a 1on1 tournament starting in February, with split divisions depending on amount of signups. For this tournament we will go for plenty of kenya including 2 completely new maps, [[Katt]] and [[Sabbath]]. Also, there is no picking preferences of maps - every match will follow a pre-determined map order.
It will be single-elimination to make the tournament extra intense and easy, where every match matters. 
== Format ==
* Single-Elimination
* '''Pre-determined map order'''
** Every match follow this fixed order: KATT, SABBATH, POCKET, BRAVADO, AEROWALK
* Division and rounds depending on signups.
* All matches are BO5, Grand Finals are BO7.
* All regions(EU/NA) welcome, matches will be on even ping.

== Rules ==
* '''Fixed map order.''' (no picking)
** All matches are Best of 5 (BO5). Grand Finals are Best of 7 (BO7 (In a BO7 the map pool resets after 5 played maps and the player trailing in maps picks the 6th map, the next player picks the 7th).
** Every match follow this exact map order: KATT, SABBATH, POCKET, BRAVADO, AEROWALK
* Settings: Standard settings by typing "/1on1" | To add match tag type "/1on1 Kombat"
* Pause rules: Each player is allowed one pause per match, once you have used a pause and use it again, you have forfeited the map.
* Ping rules: Find a server that keeps both players around the same ping +/- 13ms, if no such server can be found, the lowest ping player will have to use cl_delay_packet to get closer to the higher ping player. If there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin on discord. 
** Matches between NA/EU are suggested to play on UK/IE/NY servers.
** Players from Brazil playing in EU can request to play on Portugal server.
** However, if only one of the players from different regions are able to get below 110 ping on UK/IE/NY/PT servers  the game cannot be forced to be played on a server for higher than 110 ping. (example: Brazil vs EU cannot be forced to Miami for 150 even ping, then it will be played on UK/IE/NY/PT with ~110 vs ~150 ping). 
* Client: ezquake 3.6.x. or unezquake 1.3.x. For your own sake, update your client!
** Remember to check with f_version
* Ruleset(ezquake): smackdown
* unezquake settings: If using unezquake: "F_ruleset check's must report CLEAR in ruleset check"
** Remember to check with f_ruleset
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>. Or in the Kombat discord channel #reports.
* cl_idrive is NOT allowed, turn off your hardware SOCD functions if you have them.
